Advertisement

100 Example Dr, Exampleton, KY, 40000-3218

Alder Care Consulting & Solutions Solutions, located in Exampleton, KY, offers guidance and resources for families navigating Alder care. Services include Alder living placement, in-home care coordination, and dementia care assistance, along with business consulting for Alder care organizations.

The business emphasizes safety and peace of mind through personalized assessments and technology solutions. They provide free consultations to help clients make informed decisions about their loved ones' care needs.
